claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately reflects the requirement under subsection (a)(1) that the chief executive officer designate an appropriate State agency complying with paragraph (2) as the lead agency.
The claim captures the lead agency duty under subsection (a)(2)(A) to develop the State plan for submission to the Secretary under subsection (b).
The claim accurately states the lead agency duty to hold at least one public hearing with statewide distribution of notice to allow public comment on the proposed use and distribution of funds.
The claim accurately captures the lead agency duty under subsection (a)(2)(C) to conduct reviews of eligible entities under section 9914.
The claim correctly reflects the eligibility requirement under subsection (a)(3) for the State to hold at least one legislative hearing every 3 years in conjunction with State plan development.

The claim faithfully reflects the introductory requirements of subsection (b) regarding plan duration (1 to 2 fiscal years), submission deadline (30 days prior), and required content beginning in fiscal year 2000.
The claim captures the full substance of subsection (b)(1)(A) including all enumerated target groups, goals, and partnerships.
The claim faithfully represents the assurance under subsection (b)(1)(B) concerning youth development programs and innovative crime prevention models.
The claim accurately covers the assurance under subsection (b)(1)(C) regarding coordination with other programs including State welfare reform efforts.
The claim correctly reflects subsection (b)(2) regarding descriptions of discretionary fund usage and innovative community initiatives.
The claim accurately incorporates all elements of information provided by eligible entities under subsection (b)(3)(A)-(D).
The claim correctly states the assurance under subsection (b)(4) regarding emergency services and supplies to counteract starvation and malnutrition.
The claim accurately represents the assurance under subsection (b)(5) concerning coordination with social services and workforce development systems.
The claim properly details the assurance under subsection (b)(6) regarding antipoverty coordination and Title XXVI emergency energy crisis intervention.
The claim accurately captures the assurance under subsection (b)(7) to permit and cooperate with Federal investigations under section 9916.
The claim correctly articulates the procedural protections and cause requirements under subsection (b)(8) for terminating or reducing eligible entity funding.
The claim faithfully records the assurance under subsection (b)(9) regarding partnerships and coordination with community, religious, and charitable organizations.
The claim accurately reflects the assurance under subsection (b)(10) requiring petition procedures for adequate representation on eligible entity boards.
The claim captures the assurance under subsection (b)(11) to secure a community action plan including a community-needs assessment as a condition of funding.
The claim properly reflects the performance measurement assurance and outcome description requirements under subsection (b)(12).
The claim correctly conveys the requirement under subsection (b)(13) to provide information describing how the State will carry out the assurances.
The claim accurately reflects the statutory definition and scope of 'cause' in the context of funding reductions under subsection (c)(1).
The claim accurately defines 'cause' with respect to funding terminations under subsection (c)(2).
The claim correctly states the Secretary's discretionary authority under subsection (d) to prescribe assessment procedures.
The claim captures the governor's permissive authority under subsection (e)(1) to revise any State plan prepared under the section.
The claim correctly conveys the mandatory requirement under subsection (e)(1) to submit any revised plan to the Secretary.
The claim accurately reflects the requirement under subsection (e)(2) to make plans and revised plans available for public inspection within the State.
The claim accurately captures the transitional rule under subsection (f) applicable to fiscal year 2000 applications and plans.
